text_block_list.text: One day, with the Osaka Hai drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-san isn't running in the Osaka Hai?
choice_data_list: Sounds like it was just a mild sprain.

text_block_list.text: Her injury wasn't severe enough to warrant major concern, but she explained that she would be resting just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... However,
defeating an Oguri-san who isn't in peak condition is meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let us wait for the opportunity
when Miss Oguri recovers and is able to race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san, it seems a large pile of boxes
has been left sitting in the entryway.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a package for Oguri-senpai.
I'm on my way to carry it to her room right now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll help.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
With the two of us carrying them, it'll be done in no time!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Yaeno.
It was a big help having you organize the contents too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No. If I kept them in their boxes, they would've encroached all the way onto my bed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I was quite surprised.
To think that entire mountain of boxes was all fan presents."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It seems they sent it after finding out about my injury.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"To ease the burden on your legs even a little,
I'm sending you a leg pillow. Please use this
and get plenty of rest"...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so happy.
It really cheers me up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone's cheering always gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You truly cherish
all your fans, don't you, Oguri-san?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Without the support of Tome-san, Shige-san... and everyone in Kasamatsu, I wouldn't be standing here today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right. Yone-san sent over some
nukazuke pickles. Care for some, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, taking food from you, Oguri-san,
would just be far too presumptuous of me...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"A token of my appreciation for today.
Yone-san's nukazuke is delicious, you know."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well then... I'll join you.
If you don't mind, may I offer you
some of my homemade miso soup?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: !! You are more than welcome to!
(*munch, munch... chew, chew...*)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal.
The nukazuke pickles had just the right amount of salt.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You can really feel Yone-san's thoughtful wish
for everyone to enjoy a delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mm. That is why eating it warms the heart.
And the other gifts are the same.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I feel completely empty...
remembering this warmth gives me strength."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, seconds it is.
I've got to eat a lot and heal up fast.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I, too, am eagerly awaiting
Oguri-san's return.
Please take good care of yourself.
And on the day of the Osaka Hai—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san isn't running, but Creek-san,
whom I fought in the Kikuka Sho, is here today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho...
A race that carries the bitter memory of my pathetic performance...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Despite declaring that I would run a race worthy of Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san,
I failed to keep that promise...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Today, without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Without fail, I will run a race both of you can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To show our presence to the spectators, we cannot afford to show anything less than our best running!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
While burning with this "obsession," I shall master it
and seize victory with a run that reaches the pinnacle of "Fire and Water as One"!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Go show them what you've got.
Yeah! Go show 'em what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's demeanor is so cool!
She's got such an imposing presence, I love it.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely cool. ...Still,
today is all about Super Creek, right?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Super Creek feels like she has
talent on par with Oguri Cap.
She's gotta be strong!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Oguri-tier, huh? Then we can definitely expect great things!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Even when she isn't here,
everyone still talks about Oguri-san's strength...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(The place I must reach is the same.
So that Chiyono O-san and the others
won't be forgotten even in their absence...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I will sear my running into the audience's minds,
and protect the place where the two of you can return!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That is precisely why. In this race, I will surpass Creek-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will overwrite your reputation with my own name!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... that would be a problem.
I must bring good news to the person
waiting for my victory.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Still... Yaeno-chan seems somewhat different from how she was at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's like... having a single, solid core
running straight down the middle.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—You have a remarkably keen eye.
It is truly worthy of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, feels like it's going to be a good race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this fair and square!!
